title: Tools Saver
description: Durability Saver is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly client-side mod that prevents tools from breaking by stopping actions at 1 durability — with a simple on/off toggle and a clean HUD indicator.
body:
🛡️ Tools Saver

Never break your tools again.

Tools Saver is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly client-side mod that prevents your tools from breaking by stopping actions at 1 durability — giving you just enough time to react.

⚡ Features
🛑 Break prevention
Automatically stops mining or attacking when your tool reaches 1 durability
🎮 Toggleable
Turn it on or off anytime with a keybind
🟢🔴 Status indicator
Clean top-left HUD shows:
ON (green)
OFF (red)
Current toggle key
💬 Action bar alerts
Notifies you when the mod blocks a break
🧩 Client-side only
Works on any server, including vanilla
🎯 Why use it?

Breaking a fully enchanted tool is one of the most frustrating things in survival.

Tools Saver prevents that moment — without adding clutter, unfair advantages, or changing the feel of vanilla gameplay.

⚙️ Requirements
Minecraft 26.1
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
💡 Design Philosophy
Vanilla-friendly
Lightweight
No unnecessary features
Just solves a real problem
🚀 Future Plans
Armor durability protection
Configurable thresholds
Optional sound alerts
